about.description1: Hello! Since the age of 3-4 I've been developing (mainly games, on platforms like the Godot Engine) for entertainment and as a hobby.

geradorabntdemo.about.howItWorks: This system works like this: the URL sent is processed (and is not stored), the site's metadata is extracted, and then formatted in the ABNT model.
geradorabntdemo.about.knownLimitations.b: Since it works based on metadata structured by website creators, some simpler or poorly structured pages may present errors or fail.
Some sites block bots from entering for security reasons. Therefore, they cannot be accessed by this system.
geradorabntdemo.about.knownLimitations.c: There are limits on the content and size of the site: only HTML is accepted. Links to videos and PDFs cannot be read by the system and will fail if placed; and a very large site may not be read correctly.
geradorabntdemo.about.knownLimitations.i: Each link query is isolated. That is, it is not possible to send more than one link at a time or assemble a single bibliography with multiple links.
